node.title: E1 high-cofactor Schinzel height collapse
node.closure: sharp entropy bound plus Schinzel's totally real height theorem
node.statement: At one fixed prize row and primitive quotient root, each profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor branch 4, 8, or 16 contains at most one negacyclic shift/sign orbit. The exact deficit is below 6.845; a sharp entropy extremum bounds every associate log L1 below 61.29, while Schinzel's theorem forces every non-torsion real unit above 128 log(phi)>61.595. Hence the three branches contribute at most three orbits in total.
